# Test fixtures — Yamaha THR-II `.thrl6p` presets

These files are functional device data (not creative works): single-preset
`.thrl6p` JSON files exported from the THR Remote app, kept so the THR-II
reader can be checked against what the app produces.

- `kj1.thrl6p`, `bassd dled.thrl6p`, `dled heavy 3.thrl6p`,
  `dled crunch 4.3.thrl6p` — the project author's own presets, shared for the
  format mapping.

The `.thrl6p` format is a Line 6 `L6Preset` schema (version 5) JSON document,
reverse-engineered by the community:
- https://github.com/f3sty/Yamaha_THRII_presets
- https://github.com/mtremoulet/GuitarSkills/blob/master/references/yamaha-thrl6p-format.md
